cues: But electron withdrawing groups switch the reactivity back on.
Put a nitro group para to the chlorine, and hydrolysis needs only aqueous sodium hydroxide at four thirty five kelvin.
Two nitro groups, and warm sodium carbonate is enough.
Three, picryl chloride, and boiling water alone does it.
A nitro group ortho or para lets the negative charge of the intermediate spread onto its oxygens.
In the meta position it has almost no effect.
text: But electron withdrawing groups switch the reactivity back on. Put a nitro group para to the chlorine, and hydrolysis needs only aqueous sodium hydroxide at four thirty five kelvin. Two nitro groups, and warm sodium carbonate is enough. Three, picryl chloride, and boiling water alone does it. A nitro group ortho or para lets the negative charge of the intermediate spread onto its oxygens. In the meta position it has almost no effect.
